name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability for Moon Panel
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What problem does this solve?

Describe the use case in your own words. What are you trying to accomplish
that the current feature set doesn't cover?

## Proposed solution

How you imagine this working from a user's perspective. Sketches, wireframes,
or links to similar implementations elsewhere are welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways you could solve the same problem (with existing features, an
external tool, a workaround). Helps us understand whether this is the right
shape of solution.

## Additional context

Links, screenshots from comparable tools, related issues, anything else.

---

> **Heads up**: Moon Panel is a single-user panel by design — feature
> requests around multi-user accounts, SSO / OAuth, email registration,
> or telemetry are out of scope. See the *Roadmap* and *Things we won't
> accept* sections of [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the
> full list before opening.
